source_note: Based on published OSHA/NWS heat index risk categories (Caution / Extreme Caution / Danger / Extreme Danger). OSHA publishes these in Fahrenheit — Celsius equivalents below are provided so they can be compared directly against FortyGuard's Celsius output. Use apparent_temperature_celsius at the actual work hour for risk decisions, NOT heat_index_celsius, which peaks around 2am due to a known API quirk (see project notes).

tiers.guidance: Basic hydration reminders; no schedule change needed.
Increase water break frequency; watch for early heat-illness symptoms.
Mandatory scheduled rest breaks; buddy system; consider rescheduling non-essential tasks.
Stop non-essential outdoor work; move to shaded/cooled areas.
